# KENOS

> L'anti-réseau social — the anti-social network. A digital sanctuary for
> cognitive offloading: cast an intimate thought into a cosmic anonymous
> ether, sealed AES-256-GCM on your device. Exactly one stranger will ever
> read it, through a single 10-second window; then it destroys itself.
> No accounts, no likes, no comments, no feed.

Key facts:

- French-first PWA (works offline once installed, no account, no install gate)
- Single-read atomic consumption server-side; the server never sees plaintext
- Public-domain poem artifacts (Verlaine, Hugo, Rimbaud, Baudelaire, Shelley…)
  readable by all for one 30-day moon; a new poem is born every Monday
- Anonymity is architectural, not a promise: zero personal data, encryption
  on-device, invite links stored only as SHA-256 hashes
- Free, no ads, no trackers; funded exclusively via GitHub Sponsors
- One canonical origin (2026-09-27): the landing folds into the app —
  every other KENOS URL redirects here

Urls:

- [Application (enter the ether)](https://kenos-lemon.vercel.app/): the app itself, canonical
- [Source code](https://github.com/Jahoz/kenos): Flutter + Supabase, Polyform license
- [Support the sanctuary](https://github.com/sponsors/Jahoz)
